The '''Dellaltian Bank and Currency Exchange''' was the planetary [[Bank/Legends|banking]] institution for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]]. The immense, empty structure of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] treasure chambers housed the main branch, located on the southernmost of the planet's three continents. Being a poor society, the bank had very few tenants and operated on a primitive level compared to the financial organizations found on more advanced worlds, and was one of the few offices occupying the vaults.<ref name="HSLL" /> The main branch was supervised by a [[Steward]] and his [[Mission Commander|assistant]], prior to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
